description: young man king of darkness, an assassin, pale skin, silver hair, glowing violet eyes, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, the highest and most epic form of all, even richer and more splendid than a god, a crown of black spikes with darkness flowing down from it, a long cloak dissolving into a starless night, black armour with glowing violet lines, holding two daggers made of pure black shadow, one in each hand, the whole daggers inside the image, elegant and deadly, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same man: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, even more epic outfit and weapon of the same kind, not this outfit
